title: Daily Signal Brief No. 025 — Council slip, Mobley null, MCP cluster null
summary: The Council's formal adoption of the EU Digital Omnibus on AI did not close on Friday 26 June as scheduled; Dastra's tracker now cites 29 June (today), while Sidley + Gibson Dunn + K&L Gates keep with non-specific 'coming weeks' language and the Consilium press feed hadn't published an adoption release at brief window-close (14:05Z). Two null observations carry the rest of the brief: no second plaintiffs'-firm filing using Mobley/Lin's FEHA California-nexus theory (D+6 business days post-order; Workday silence now slightly past standard 5-business-day window); no fresh MCP-lane vendor consent-affordance ship over the 72-hour weekend (cluster sits at 3 vendors in 30 days; L2→L3 trigger of 5 vendors still active; next pivot is 6 July Greenhouse broad-MCP go-live). Three signals, one L3, two L2 watch, ~470 words. Short brief because the weekend was genuinely quiet, not because Eglin under-searched — gap named explicitly in the closing reflection.
